info.title: UtekosCommon
info.description: Reusable schemas, parameters, headers, and responses shared by Utekos HTTP API contracts. Runtime Zod schemas remain authoritative for accepted event payloads.

CanonicalEventEnvelope.description: Common envelope accepted by canonical event schemas before request-context normalization.

OriginHeader.name: Origin
OriginHeader.description: Must parse to the same origin as the requested endpoint. Missing, malformed, or cross-origin values receive 403.

CheckoutMethodHeader.name: X-Utekos-Checkout-Method
CheckoutMethodHeader.description: Authoritative checkout method for begin_checkout. Missing or invalid values currently normalize to shopify_checkout.

ContentType.description: JSON response media type when a body is present.

SetCookie.description: Page-view acceptance can set first-party browser identifier cookies.

TrafficClassification.description: Present on a 204 generated by traffic exclusion before event collection.

EventAccepted.description: The event was accepted for persistence and dispatch planning.

EventDuplicate.description: The event_id already existed and the event was treated as a duplicate.

EventSuppressed.description: No body. The route either rejected the event because both analytics and marketing consent were denied, or excluded the request from marketing dispatch during traffic classification.

InvalidRequest.description: Malformed JSON or a payload that violates the canonical event schema.

ForbiddenOrigin.description: The Origin header was missing, malformed, or did not match the request origin.

PayloadTooLarge.description: The declared or measured UTF-8 request body exceeded 32 KiB.

UnsupportedMediaType.description: The request media type was not application/json.

InternalError.description: A non-validation failure occurred while normalizing or storing the event.
